title: Simply Vulkanized
description: A vulkan optimisation and Quality Of Life modpack made for high render distances
body:
A vulkan optimisation modpack inspired by the vulkan optimised modpack but with added quality of life features also allows for higher render distances and visual upgrades.

> Note:do not allocate less than 4gb of RAM if you want a smooth experience.And have fun :)

FAQ: Why do sometimes my menu buttons dissapear and the rendering does not work?
This is a known issue and the main reason why this project is on beta.I am trying to fix it but can not do anything right now.

Inspired by:https://modrinth.com/modpack/vulkan-optimized
